Re: Claim C-1453 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Tracy Edwards in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred on 04/15/2024. Our client was
stopped at a traffic signal when the insured vehicle struck the rear of their car at a speed sufficient to cause significant impact.
The police report documents the point of impact and the resulting damage, and the at-fault driver akcnowledged at the scene that
they had not noticed the stopped traffic in time.
As a direct result of the collision, our client sustained a lumbar back strain. Symptoms began within hours and have included
persistent pain, muscle spasms, and limited mobility. Our client sought prompt medical evaluation, followed a prescribed course
of physical therapy, and has been unable to perform certain work duties and household tasks without discomfort. Treatment
records and the treating physician's notes are enclosed and confirm the diagnosis and its link to the accident.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to maintain a safe following distance and failed to keep a proper lookout, and
the resulting harm is well documented. We therefore ask that you resolve this claim by paying the sum of $197,000.00 within
thirty days of the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will proceed with filing a
civil action without further notice.
Expert review: Kendra Galloway, neurologist
Sincerely,
Stephanie Thomas
Mendez & Graham LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
